Name: Quarry Farm
Author: sadnumbme
Description:
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]A farm for those who love mining.  The farm is one big quarry with a small farming area.  You will want to build a well or get sprinklers ASAP f you plan to farm. [/color][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8]You will need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]Farm Type Manager [/url] so that items will spawn on the quarry/farm.  It will spawn a lot. [/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]You will need  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9296]Esca's Modding Plugins [/url] to get both river and lake fish from fishing. [/color]

Have fun with this farm and let me know if you run into any issues.  This farm works on both Android/Mobile and PC. 

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/sadnumbme]sadnumbme[/url]

Manifest.Name: (CP)Quarry Farm
